title: Pure Zera
summary: The Zera archetype follows the multi-path destiny of Level 4 Normal Monster Warrior of Zera across his four Level 8 2800 ATK evolutions: the Ritual boss Zera the Mant, the LIGHT Fairy boss Archlord Zerato, the DARK Fiend boss Mazera DeVille, and the Level 8 Synchro boss Angel of Zera! Use Unexpected Dai and Rescue Rabbit to Special Summon Warrior of Zera directly from your Deck, or activate Pre-Preparation of Rites and Advanced Ritual Art to dump Warrior of Zera from your Deck and Ritual Summon Zera the Mant. While The Sanctuary in the Sky is active (searched via The Sacred Waters in the Sky), Tribute Warrior of Zera to summon Archlord Zerato and discard 1 LIGHT monster to destroy all monsters your opponent controls; while Pandemonium is active, Tribute Warrior of Zera to summon Mazera DeVille and rip 3 random cards out of your opponent's hand; or tune Warrior of Zera with Level 4 Tuner Chaos Mirage Dragon into Level 8 Synchro Angel of Zera, which revives itself every time it is banished!

allow.The Sanctuary in the Sky: Field Spell required on the field to Special Summon 'Archlord Zerato' (by Tributing 1 'Warrior of Zera') AND to activate Archlord Zerato's Raigeki effect!
allow.The Sacred Waters in the Sky: Normal Spell that activates 'The Sanctuary in the Sky' directly from your Deck and searches a Sanctuary monster.
allow.Pre-Preparation of Rites: Normal Spell that adds BOTH 'Zera Ritual' and 'Zera the Mant' directly from your Deck or GY to your hand!
allow.Advanced Ritual Art: Ritual Spell that Ritual Summons Level 8 'Zera the Mant' from your hand by sending two Level 4 Normal Monster 'Warrior of Zera' directly from your Deck to the GY!
allow.Unexpected Dai: Normal Spell that Special Summons Level 4 Normal Monster 'Warrior of Zera' directly from your Deck while you control no monsters—putting Warrior of Zera on the field without using your Normal Summon so you can immediately Tribute it for Archlord Zerato or Mazera DeVille, or tune it into Angel of Zera!
allow.Rescue Rabbit: Level 4 Beast that banishes itself to Special Summon 2 copies of 'Warrior of Zera' directly from your Deck!
allow.Chaos Mirage Dragon: Level 4 LIGHT Wyrm Tuner: tunes with Level 4 'Warrior of Zera' (4 + 4 = 8) to Synchro Summon Level 8 'Angel of Zera', serves as a LIGHT monster in hand to discard for Archlord Zerato's board-wipe effect, AND Special Summons a banished LIGHT/DARK monster (or banishes an opponent's monster when used as Synchro Material for Angel of Zera, increasing Angel of Zera's ATK!)!
allow.Reinforcement of the Army: Limited to 1 in TCG: searches 'Warrior of Zera' from your Deck.
allow.Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic: Rank 8 Xyz summoned using any two of your Level 8 Zera bosses (Zera the Mant, Archlord Zerato, Darklord Zerato, Mazera DeVille, or Angel of Zera!) that negates Spells.
allow.Dingirsu, the Orcust of the Evening Star: Rank 8 Xyz summoned using any two Level 8 Zera bosses for non-targeting removal and board protection.

main: Warrior of Zera

Core Level 4 EARTH Warrior Normal Monster (1600 ATK / 1600 DEF): the origin of all Zera evolutions! Summoned from the Deck by Unexpected Dai and Rescue Rabbit, sent to the GY by Advanced Ritual Art, and Tributed on the field to Special Summon Archlord Zerato or Mazera DeVille!
Archlord Zerato

Signature Level 8 LIGHT Fairy evolution (2800 ATK / 2300 DEF): Must be Special Summoned from your hand by Tributing 1 face-up 'Warrior of Zera' while 'The Sanctuary in the Sky' is on the field; discards 1 LIGHT monster from your hand to the GY while Sanctuary is on the field to destroy ALL monsters your opponent controls!
Darklord Zerato

Level 8 DARK Fairy fallen evolution (2800 ATK / 2300 DEF): can be Tribute Summoned with 1 Tribute if you have 4+ DARK monsters with different names in your GY; sends 1 DARK monster from your hand to the GY to destroy ALL monsters your opponent controls!
Mazera DeVille

Signature Level 8 DARK Fiend corrupted evolution (2800 ATK / 2300 DEF): Must be Special Summoned from your hand by Tributing 1 face-up 'Warrior of Zera' while 'Pandemonium' is on the field; when Special Summoned this way, your opponent discards 3 random cards from their hand!
Zera the Mant

Signature Level 8 DARK Fiend Ritual evolution (2800 ATK / 2300 DEF; searchable alongside Zera Ritual by Pre-Preparation of Rites!): Ritual Summoned via Zera Ritual or Advanced Ritual Art (sending two Warrior of Zera from your Deck to the GY!).
Chaos Mirage Dragon

Level 4 LIGHT Wyrm Tuner: pairs with Level 4 Warrior of Zera (summoned via Unexpected Dai or Rescue Rabbit) to Synchro Summon Level 8 'Angel of Zera', banishes an opponent's monster when used for a Synchro Summon (boosting Angel of Zera's ATK!), and serves as LIGHT discard fodder for Archlord Zerato!
Rescue Rabbit
Banishes itself to Special Summon 2 copies of 'Warrior of Zera' directly from your Deck.
Unexpected Dai
Special Summons 'Warrior of Zera' directly from your Deck while you control no monsters.
Zera Ritual
Signature Ritual Spell (searchable by Pre-Preparation of Rites!) that Ritual Summons 'Zera the Mant' from your hand.
Advanced Ritual Art
Ritual Summons Level 8 'Zera the Mant' from your hand by sending two Level 4 'Warrior of Zera' from your Deck to the GY.
Pre-Preparation of Rites
Adds both 'Zera Ritual' and 'Zera the Mant' from your Deck or GY to your hand.
The Sacred Waters in the Sky
Activates 'The Sanctuary in the Sky' directly from your Deck so you can immediately Tribute Warrior of Zera to summon Archlord Zerato and wipe your opponent's monsters!
The Sanctuary in the Sky
Field Spell that unlocks Archlord Zerato's Special Summon condition and Raigeki effect.
Pandemonium
Field Spell that unlocks Mazera DeVille's Special Summon condition (and its 3-card hand-rip!).
Reinforcement of the Army
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Warrior of Zera.
extra: Signature Level 8 LIGHT Fairy Synchro evolution (1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners: Level 4 Chaos Mirage Dragon + Level 4 Warrior of Zera; 2800 ATK): gains 100 ATK for each of your opponent's banished cards (boosted immediately by Chaos Mirage Dragon's Synchro banish!); and during the Standby Phase of the next turn after this card was banished, Special Summons this banished card!
Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic Galaxy
Rank 8 Xyz (2 Level 8 monsters: any two of Zera the Mant, Archlord Zerato, Darklord Zerato, Mazera DeVille, or Angel of Zera!) that negates Spell activations.
Dingirsu, the Orcust of the Evening Star
Rank 8 Xyz (2 Level 8 Zera bosses) that sends an opponent's card to the GY without targeting and protects your board from destruction.
